description: This file defines the class EntitySaxReader, which is a SAX XML parser content handler for processing Entity Engine XML files in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles parsing, transforming, and loading entity data specified in XML files into the OFBiz data layer, with support for custom templates, encoding, and transaction management.

classes.name: EntitySaxReader
classes.description: A SAX ContentHandler implementation that reads and processes Entity Engine XML files, supporting features like templating, data transformation, and bulk database operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: characters
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements, appending text to the current field value or processing template content if enabled.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Processes the end of an XML element, finalizing entity creation or update, or executing template transformations.

methods.name: setDocumentLocator
methods.description: Stores the document locator to aid in error reporting and line number tracking.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, initializing entities, handling template transformation setup, and tracking action tags.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles recoverable XML parsing errors, logs warning messages.

methods.name: fatalError
methods.description: Handles fatal XML parsing errors, logs error messages, and throws exceptions.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Handles non-fatal XML parser warnings, logs warning messages.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string or URL containing XML data, initiating the SAX parsing process.
